program_solutions:
(rule!
  (paint-cells
    g
    (flatmap
      (lambda (obj)
        (if (and (= (obj-color obj) 2) (= (obj-size obj) 1))
            (let* ((p (first (obj-cells obj)))
                   (r (fst p))
                   (c (snd p)))
              (list (list r c)
                    (list (- r 1) c)
                    (list (+ r 1) c)
                    (list r (- c 1))
                    (list r (+ c 1))))
            (list)))
      (objects g 0))
    4))
